outperformance.speedup_on_piecewise_II.reason: CALM dominates both baselines at every required budget. Neither reaches the target by half the budget. The proposed-mean-plus-std dominance condition holds at all four budgets.

outperformance.speedup_on_smooth_oscilla.reason: Neither speedup threshold is met: the stricter final-error target requires approximately 495.74/500 measurements using linear interpolation of required budgets. At N=200, CALM is 0.521501±0.015453 versus gSMART 0.519209±0.014865, a 0.002292 excess within one standard deviation. This meets the tier's 'some tested budgets' condition; other official budgets favor CALM, so it is an isolated small regression, not consistent slowdown.

outperformance.speedup_on_non_differenti.reason: CALM is below both baselines at all four budgets. outperformance.speedup_on_diffusion_3d.reason: The stricter final-error target is gSMART's 2.584670 at N=1000. CALM reaches 2.395726 by the tested budget N=100, well below half the maximum budget.
